720-1806-2034-6559.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
720-1806-2034-6559.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adidng {C}{C}.
When Eternal Scourge dies, Kinzu of the Bleak Coven and Venerated Stormsinger trigger.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Kinzu of the Bleak Coven trigger, causing you to pay 2 life and exile Eternal Scourge from your graveyard to create a token copy of it that is 1/1.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Eternal Scourge token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Eternal Scourge token dies, Venerated Stormsinger triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.

1933-2226-6751.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
1933-2226-6751.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Starfield Vocalist.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Aether Adept by paying its mana cost.
When Aether Adept enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.

Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Thran Vigil trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Remove a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.

Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Repeat.
1981-2415-6495-6772.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

Smaug triggers, creating two artifact tokens due to Adrix and Nev.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the two artifact tokens, returning Metalwork Colossus from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.

Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1806-2060-2438-2445-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Branching Evolution.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

3967-6255-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
3967-6255-7084.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Zahur and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Zahur trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2308-4871-5231-6720.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain any amount of life.
2308-4871-5231-6720.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {R}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Case of the Uneaten Feast trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

Repeat.

708-2060-4050-4153-6775.description:
Cast Dyadrine from the command zone by paying {G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable, reduced by {1} for each time you've cast Dyadrine this game from the command zone due to Myth Unbound. Dyadrine will enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it for each mana spent to cast it.

Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing all +1/+1 counters placed on it in step 4, adding {G}{W} and then {1} for each remaining counter.
Repeat.

215-955-4010-6723.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton by paying at least {3}{G}{W}
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and three Food tokens.
Activate Farmer Cotton, three Halflings and three Foods by tapping them, adding {4}{G}{G}{W}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Farmer Cotton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
215-955-4010-6723.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} additional to start to get infinite untapped tokens. This mana will be recuperated throughout the combo.

997-2577-4871.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional Zombie.
You control another Zombie.
997-2577-4871.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

465-719-2079-3742-4251.notablePrerequisites: Xenograft on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
465-719-2079-3742-4251.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

When the Forest Dryad enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Obuun trigger.
Resolve the Obuun trigger, putting a counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Luminous Broodmoth and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, returning Reassembling Skeleton from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.

Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia abilities from steps 1 and 5, causing target player to mill cards equal to twice Reassembling Skeleton's power.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Resolve the Jenny Flint trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.

Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1, causing target player to mill three cards.
Repeat.

1003-1494-1778-2356-2366-2890-3652-4892.description:
Cast Flash putting Protean Hulk into play, choosing not to pay.
Sacrifice Hulk, getting Ezuri, Sage of Hours, and 4 0 mana value creatures.
Sage of Hours and the 4 creatures will trigger Ezuri's ability, netting you 5 experience counters.
Move to combat, triggering Ezuri's ability.
Put 5 +1/+1 counters from Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours' ability, removing all 5 counters, giving you an extra turn.
Repeat steps 4 and 5 for infinite turns.
